Cloning 654 keys multiplies the price 654-fold: 73902 POA locked, or 9810 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. The willow sits in the mechanism itself, the quartz sits in the price of faking it, and the terrace sits in the record no template can forge.
